entries.source: Lorenz Fries, Hohe Registratur, entry 1529, Standbuch 1011 fol. 99v; citing Liber 4 contractuum Rudolfi f. 161ff.; modern reference: StA Würzburg, ldf 15, S. 343ff.
entries.german: Steffan von Bibra lag in des stiffts dienest gegen den Rosenberg nider. Darfur vertruge sich B. Rudolf uf sontag nach Divisionis Apostolorum mit ime anno 1481, und gab ime fur seine entwerte 7 pferde, harnisch, scheden, zerung etc. 400 fl.
entries.english: Stefan von Bibra served the bishopric in fighting against the von Rosenbergs. In compensation, Bishop Rudolf reached an agreement with him on the Sunday after the Division of the Apostles in 1481 and gave him 400 florins for the loss of seven horses, armor, damages, expenses, and other costs. The database comment notes that the copybook gives the year as 1491.

facts.content: served the bishopric in fighting against the von Rosenberg family.
compensated Stefan von Bibra with 400 florins for his losses of seven horses, armor, damages, expenses, and other costs.
